label: TP
reason: User-supplied header names are passed directly into HTML output via ESAPI.encodeForHTML(), which only encodes attribute/script contexts but does not encode entity characters like '<' or '>' needed for script tags. This allows bypassing XSS filters by injecting payloads such as '<script>alert(1)</script>' through header names.

evidence.note: Parameter extracted from HTTP headers without decoding or validation
Unsanitized parameter written to HTML response via encodeForHTML()
